notes.title: The Last Big Update before the Full release of the game
notes.notes:
This update has:
- Many bug fixes
- Intro Cutscene was added
- Chapter 4 is now fully working and aviable to play
- A new Moveset for Aleister
- Many performance upgrades
- A completely new UI
- Faster loadtimes
- Many Cutscene improvements

notes.title: Gameplay Update
notes.notes:
This are the improvements and changes that we did for the game:
- Better Combat System, with more responsive attacks for all the characters
- Better Enemy AI
- Some bug fixed with the Items
- New Attacks for Aleister, Lilluza and Naga
- Some Cutscenes have now been improved 
- New Particle effects for the swords trail
- Improved audio quality

notes.title: Upcoming Update
notes.notes:
